description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a non-React utility `createProgressiveExpandController` for managing progressive batch processing of work items in a non-blocking, incremental manner. It includes functions to start processing items in batches, track progress, handle cancellation, and integrate with React component state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object for processing items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. Provides start and cancel methods, progress tracking, and handles adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, managing UI state (running, progress, counts) around the batch processing, allowing React components to initiate and cancel progressive work.
